scripts.build: cargo build --workspace --release --locked && bun run --cwd web build
scripts.typecheck: cargo check --workspace --locked && bun run --cwd web typecheck
scripts.test: cargo test --workspace --locked && bun run --cwd web test
scripts.check: bun run fmt:check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test
scripts.lint: cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings && bun run --cwd web lint
scripts.fmt: cargo fmt --all && bun run --cwd web fmt
scripts.fmt:check: cargo fmt --all --check && bun run --cwd web fmt:check
